ProgramUnit.Name: QUERY_HAS_RESULT
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION QUERY_HAS_RESULT RETURN NUMBER IS
 V_COUNT NUMBER := 0;
BEGIN
 :PARAMETER.P_DCLTN_ISN := NULL;
 IF :R_G1 = 1 THEN
 BEGIN
 SELECT DCLTN_ISN INTO :PARAMETER.P_DCLTN_ISN
 FROM DECLARATIONS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :P_PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_NBR = :DCLTN_NBR
 AND DCLTN_DT = :DCLTN_DT
 ;
 EXCEPTION WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 RETURN V_COUNT;
 END;
 END IF;
 
 SELECT 1 
 INTO V_COUNT
 FROM DUAL
 WHERE EXISTS
 (
 SELECT DATA.PORT_CD, DATA.DCLTN_NBR ,DATA.DCLTN_DT , DATA.DCLTN_TYPE_CD , DATA.ITEM_ISN, DATA.ITEM_SEQ, DATA.DCLTN_ISN, DATA.INV_ISN,
 DATA.BRKR_TARIFF_CD, DATA.BRKR_TARIFF_DT, DATA.FINAL_TARIFF_CD,DATA.ITEM_DESC,
 DATA.FINAL_TARIFF_DT, DATA.DUTY_TYPE, DATA.PNLTY_RQR, DATA.TRF_UNIT_QTY,
 DATA.MIN_DUTY_UNIT_QTY, DATA.ADD_FEE_UNIT_QTY, DATA.INV_COST, DATA.CIF_COST,
 DATA.CSTMS_COST, DATA.GROSS_WT, DATA.ORGNL_DUTY, DATA.EXMTD_DUTY, DATA.INV_TYPE,
 DATA.SHPMT_EXPS, DATA.SHPMT_CURCY_CD, DATA.SHPMT_EXPS_PCTG, DATA.INS_EXPS,
 DATA.INS_CURCY_CD, DATA.OTHER_EXPS, DATA.OTHER_CURCY_CD,
 DATA.AIR_SHPMT_EXPS, DATA.DISC_PCTG, DATA.TOTAL_EXPS, DATA.INV_CURCY_CD , ACT.USER_ID , ACT.ACTVY_DATE 
 FROM (
 SELECT IT_FILTER.PORT_CD, IT_FILTER.ITEM_ISN, IT_FILTER.ITEM_SEQ, IT_FILTER.DCLTN_ISN, IT_FILTER.INV_ISN,
 IT_FILTER.BRKR_TARIFF_CD, IT_FILTER.BRKR_TARIFF_DT, IT_FILTER.FINAL_TARIFF_CD,
 IT_FILTER.FINAL_TARIFF_DT, IT_FILTER.DUTY_TYPE, IT_FILTER.PNLTY_RQR, IT_FILTER.TRF_UNIT_QTY,
 IT_FILTER.MIN_DUTY_UNIT_QTY, IT_FILTER.ADD_FEE_UNIT_QTY, IT_FILTER.INV_COST, IT_FILTER.CIF_COST, IT_FILTER.ITEM_DESC,
 IT_FILTER.CSTMS_COST, IT_FILTER.GROSS_WT, IT_FILTER.ORGNL_DUTY, IT_FILTER.EXMTD_DUTY, INV.INV_TYPE,
 INV.SHPMT_EXPS, INV.SHPMT_CURCY_CD, INV.SHPMT_EXPS_PCTG, INV.INS_EXPS,
 INV.INS_CURCY_CD, INV.OTHER_EXPS, INV.OTHER_CURCY_CD,
 INV.AIR_SHPMT_EXPS, INV.DISC_PCTG, INV.TOTAL_EXPS, INV.INV_CURCY_CD,
 DECL_FILTER.DCLTN_NBR,DECL_FILTER.DCLTN_DT, DECL_FILTER.DCLTN_TYPE_CD
 FROM DCLTN_INVOICES INV , 
 (SELECT * FROM DCLTN_ITEMS IT WHERE NVL(IT.CSTMS_COST,0) <>0) IT_FILTER , 
 ( SELECT * FROM DECLARATIONS DECL 
 WHERE (DECL.PORT_CD = :P_PORT_CD) AND 
 ( DCLTN_TYPE_CD = :DCLTN_TYPE OR :DCLTN_TYPE IS NULL) AND 
 ( ( (DECL.DCLTN_DT>= :START_DT ) AND (DECL.DCLTN_DT<= :END_DT) AND (:START_DT IS NOT NULL) ) OR ( (DECL.PORT_CD = :P_PORT_CD) AND (DECL.DCLTN_ISN = :PARAMETER.P_DCLTN_ISN) AND (:PARAMETER.P_DCLTN_ISN IS NOT NULL) ) ) 
 ) DECL_FILTER
 WHERE DECL_FILTER.PORT_CD = IT_FILTER.PORT_CD AND DECL_FILTER.DCLTN_ISN = IT_FILTER.DCLTN_ISN AND IT_FILTER.PORT_CD = INV.PORT_CD
 AND IT_FILTER.INV_ISN = INV.INV_ISN
 ) DATA , ACTIVITY_TRANSACTIONS ACT
 WHERE ACT.SYSOBJ_ID = 21 AND ACT.SUBJ_CODE = 3 AND ACT.ACTVY_TYPE =6 AND ACT.ACTVY_SUB_ID = :P_PORT_CD || '!' || DATA.ITEM_ISN AND ACT.ACTVY_ISN IN
 (SELECT MAX (ACT1.ACTVY_ISN) FROM ACTIVITY_TRANSACTIONS ACT1 WHERE ACT1.SYSOBJ_ID = 21 AND ACT1.SUBJ_CODE = 3 AND ACT1.ACTVY_TYPE =6 AND
 ACT1.ACTVY_SUB_ID = :P_PORT_CD || '!' || DATA.ITEM_ISN ));
 
 RETURN V_COUNT;
EXCEPTION WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 RETURN V_COUNT;
END;
